title: Koncert Pricing in 2026: Plans, Add-Ons and Alternatives
summary: Koncert doesn't publish prices: its four dialer plans are quote-only. See what its own pages say about plans, add-ons and fair use, plus priced alternatives.
body_markdown:
Koncert does not publish prices for its dialer plans. Its pricing page lists four plans, Melody, Symphony, Melody+ and Symphony+, each with a Get Pricing button and no price. It states no seat minimum, billing term or free trial. One Koncert FAQ says dialer subscriptions start as low as $39 per user a month. Read on November 11, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. Every Koncert detail below comes from Koncert's own website, opened on November 11, 2026. No price here comes from a review site, and no paid Koncert account was used. For a feature-by-feature view, see[Trellus vs. Koncert](https://www.trellus.ai/compare/trellus-vs-koncert) .


## Koncert pricing at a glance


Koncert's[pricing page](https://www.koncert.com/pricing) names the plans and what they include. It gives no dollar amount, monthly or annual, for any of them.

The page ends with a contact form. It asks where the company is based and how many reps prospect by phone. The smallest team-size option is 1 to 2 reps.


## What changes the real cost of Koncert


Because the price comes from a quote, the useful question is what goes into that quote. Koncert's pages point to four things.


### The plan and the number of lines


The four plans differ in two ways. Melody and Melody+ dial a single line. Symphony dials 1 to 4 lines and Symphony+ dials 1 to 5. The two plus plans add AI objection detection and AI summary notes and transcriptions.


All four cards list the same base features, such as call recordings, voicemail sequencing, lead pooling, a remote salesfloor, and live call listen and whisper. So the plan choice is about line count and the two AI features.


### The $39 starting figure


One dollar figure appears on the Koncert pages read for this article. An FAQ on Koncert's[Data Researcher page](https://www.koncert.com/koncert-data-researcher) says a Koncert dialer subscription starts as low as $39 per user a month.


The FAQ does not say which dialer, plan or billing term that figure applies to. The pricing page gives no price for Melody, Symphony, Melody+ or Symphony+. Treat $39 as a floor to ask about, not as the price of a parallel dialing plan.


### Add-ons


The pricing page lists add-ons that work with any plan, including Koncert Phone, AI Voice Agent, AI PitchLab, Koncert Cadence and Waterfall Data Enrichment. None has a published price.


The[Koncert Phone page](https://www.koncert.com/koncert-phone) shows two plans of its own, Koncert Phone and Koncert Phone Advanced, both behind a Get Pricing button. It lists international minutes and international caller IDs as further add-ons.


### Calling usage and the fair use policy


The dialer plan cards on the pricing page state no minutes allowance. Koncert Phone lists unlimited inbound and outbound minutes, subject to Koncert's[Fair and Reasonable Use Policy](https://www.koncert.com/fair-and-reasonable-use-policy) . That policy says unlimited calling plans are meant for normal business-to-business calling. It defines typical use as the calling patterns of at least 95% of subscribers on the same plan.


The policy says Koncert may move a subscriber with unusual usage to a different calling plan at that plan's rates. It also describes a Group B international calling subscription, priced in the order form, with a fair usage limit of up to 500 minutes per user a month. Calls beyond that limit may carry additional charges.


The policy lists some uses that need Koncert's written approval first. These include use by appointment-setting firms, lead generation firms, telemarketing firms, call centers and B2C calling firms. A buyer in one of those groups should raise it before signing.


### Contract terms


Koncert's pricing page does not state a contract length, a renewal rule or a monthly option. The fair use policy refers to an order form for pricing. Ask for the term, the renewal date and the rules for adding or removing seats in writing.


## Who Koncert fits and who it does not


Koncert fits a team that wants a choice of dialing modes from one vendor. Its plans cover single-line dialing and parallel dialing on up to five lines, and every plan lists coaching tools such as live call listen and whisper.


It also fits a team that is comfortable buying through a sales conversation. The quote form's smallest option is 1 to 2 reps, so the page does not rule out small teams.


Koncert is a weaker fit for a buyer who needs a public price to build a budget or to compare vendors quickly. The pricing page puts no price on any plan or add-on, and it states no contract term. It is also not the match for someone who wants to buy a seat online the same day. The pricing page offers a Get Pricing button and a contact form, not a checkout.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does Koncert cost?


Koncert does not publish prices for its four dialer plans. Each plan on its pricing page has a Get Pricing button. An FAQ on Koncert's Data Researcher page says dialer subscriptions start as low as $39 per user a month, without naming the dialer, plan or billing term. Add-on prices are not published either.


### Does Koncert offer a free trial?


Koncert's pricing page does not list a free trial. It shows a Get Pricing button on each plan and a contact form that asks for company location and the number of reps who prospect by phone. Ask Koncert whether a trial or pilot is available before you commit to a term.


### What plans does Koncert sell?


Koncert's pricing page lists four dialer plans. Melody is a single-line power dialer. Symphony is a parallel dialer on 1 to 4 lines. Melody+ and Symphony+ add AI objection detection and AI summary notes and transcriptions, and Symphony+ dials 1 to 5 lines. Add-ons such as Koncert Phone are listed separately.


### Is calling unlimited on Koncert?


Koncert Phone lists unlimited inbound and outbound minutes, subject to Koncert's Fair and Reasonable Use Policy. The policy says unlimited calling is meant for normal business-to-business use and that Koncert may move unusual usage to another calling plan. The dialer plan cards on the pricing page state no minutes allowance.


### Which Koncert alternatives publish their prices?


On November 11, 2026, Trellus listed Power at $99.99 and Power + Parallel at $149.99 per seat a month. WAVV Multi Line was $149 billed monthly. PhoneBurner started at $165 billed monthly or $140 billed annually. Salesfinity Gold was $299 month to month or $249 billed annually.
